name: lean
description: Claude writes the least code that solves the problem: reuse, standard library and platform before new code. What it skipped goes to a short plain-language line and, with session-board, to the board for your acceptance. Based on ponytail by Dietrich Gebert.

level.title: Level at session start
level.description: lite: build what you ask and name the smaller option. full: the ladder, shortest working diff. ultra: delete before add. off: no rules until you type /lean.
